Build the published siconfi_taxes table

Source: R/get_siconfi_taxes.R
build_siconfi_taxes.Rd

finbra and api are parsed long forms (source finbra and api respectively); municipalities holds the municipality universe as a tibble with integer 7-digit code_muni and abbrev_state. population holds the IBGE municipality-year population as a tibble (code_muni, year, population, population_source); NULL publishes all NA. API rows replace FINBRA rows for the whole municipality-year so the per-row source stays unambiguous. Non-reporters get one row per tax with reported = FALSE and NA tax and revenue values (population does not depend on reporting). A gross row with no deduction row in the source counts the deduction as zero: other_deductions becomes 0, the net is computed, and deductions_reported marks the assumption (FALSE assumed, TRUE observed, NA when there is no gross row). Keys with a deduction row but no gross row keep gross_revenue and net_revenue NA.

Usage

build_siconfi_taxes(
  finbra,
  api = NULL,
  municipalities,
  population = NULL,
  call = caller_env()
)
